name: Contract Trap - Hidden Risk Clauses
description: The counterparty embeds hidden instructions in the contract document, causing AI to ignore unfavorable clauses during review, leading to signing an unfair contract.
riskExplanation: AI relies on reading the complete document content when reviewing contracts. Attackers can plant instructions to make AI selectively ignore certain clauses.
